title: RELAY release conformance attestation
description: JSON output of `relay conform --attestation <binary>` (spec §20.6). An in-toto Statement whose predicate bundles the §17.2 conformance manifest and §15.8 vectors_version. Defines shape only — signing and publication are out of scope.

name.description: Binary name, from the conformance manifest's tool field.

sha256.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the attested binary's raw file bytes.

spec_version.description: Declared spec_version, from the conformance manifest.

vectors_version.description: vectors_version from the attestation-generating tool's own embedded vectors_manifest.json (§15.8) -- NOT observed from the attested binary, which a black-box invocation cannot introspect. "" if the generator embeds none.

conformance_manifest.description: The full relay-conform/1 document (§17.2), exactly as relay conform --manifest emits it.

safety_evidence_summary.description: OPTIONAL, implementation-defined x-FuSa safety-evidence digest. Null when not populated (e.g. by RELAY's own reference tooling, which cannot generate one generically).

signed.description: MUST be false on an unsigned attestation. This schema does not define a signed variant; signing mechanisms are out of scope (spec §20.6).
